about_the_game:
My Cozy Bookshop is a charming blend of shop management sim and light RPG, set in a colorful fantasy world full of magical readers, curious wanderers, and mysterious tomes.

When your grandma decides to retire to a tropical island to finally finish writing her book, she hands the family bookshop over to you—with no room for negotiation. The only thing you do get a say in? Renaming the place and making it your own.

📚 Run Your Own Bookshop

Stock your shelves, decorate the shop and help a variety of quirky customers find their next favorite read—whether it’s a wizard in need of spellbooks, a hopeless romantic, or a humble reader just looking to unwind.

🌿 Explore and Collect

Step outside the shop and explore a vibrant, stylized world. Forage for rare books hidden in forgotten ruins or quiet forests, gather herbs and flowers, and bring your finds back to enhance your shop.

🧪 Grow and Customize

Plant herbs for potion crafting, decorate your space with cozy touches, and upgrade the shop to unlock new spells, recipes, regions, and storylines.

🧙‍♂️ Features:

  • Manage and grow your own magical bookshop

  • Sell to unique, fantasy-inspired customers

  • Forage for rare books and resources in the wild

  • Brew potions and decorate with herbal plants

  • Expand your shop and unlock magical upgrades

  • Rename the store and make it your own!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GT 710
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560

short_description: Run your own magical bookshop in a cozy fantasy world! Sell to curious customers, explore for rare books, gather herbs, and grow your store into a spell-filled haven. Grandma’s retired — the shop is yours now. Time to give it a name and make it your own.
